acceptanceCriteria: Owner records a decision: accept 40% as meeting the target, or authorise the Landlock qualification and ci-control-plane change.
V1-0246 and V1-0081 are updated, closed or re-scoped accordingly.
body: In lane speed-1021 one edit still selects 144 of 357 test packages (40%). Further bounding of cmd/corvint needs Linux Landlock qualification and ci-control-plane admin approval. Owner must decide whether 40% satisfies the 'well under half' target, or authorise the Landlock qualification and CI control-plane change. Links: V1-0246, V1-0081. Versions: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 698); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.698. Source: lane speed-1021, PR beamfall/corvint#1416, 2026-10-21.
title: Decision: does one edit selecting 144 of 357 packages (40%) meet "well under half" for V1-0246/V1-0081?
